title: Ye Beemaar kehta tha kufe me
body:
Ye beemar kehta tha kufe me badhkar, hum aal e nabi hai humein na sataao
Tamaasha hamara na yu tum banao, hum aal e nabi hai humein na sataao
1. Na gham taaziyaano ka na bediyon ka, hai gham maaon behno ki bepardagi ka
Khule sar inhein na yahan par phirao, hum aal e nabi hai humein na sataao
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Hai behna meri jiska naam hai sakina, hai pyaasi wo itni ke jalta hai seena
Na tum usko paani dikhaake bahaao, hum aal e nabi hai humein na sataao
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Jo naaqe se bachi giri thi zameen par, to sar mere ghazi ka rota tha kehkar
Abhi karwan tum na aage badhaao, hum aal e nabi hai humein na sataao
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Phupi meri parde me rehti thi aise, ke jisko khule sar na sooraj bhi dekhe
Use aise majme me tum na phiraao, hum aal e nabi hai humein na sataao
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Yu naize se sar jo chacha ka hai girta, sabab iska hai meri phupiyo ka parda
Khula sar phupi ka na unko dikhaao, hum aal e nabi hai humein na sataao
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Tha abid pe sabse kadha waqt us jaa, ke darbar me jab gayi’n bint e zehra
Ye kehta tha hakim, ta-arruf karao, hum aal e nabi hai humein na sataao
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Karo asghari milke syed ka matam, awaalim me barpa hai syed ka maatam
Ye rudaad
Mirza
sabhi ko sunaao, hum aal e nabi hai humein na sataao
Kalaam : Mirza Hassan Ali Baig
